# Appropriation Ordinance No. 04, Series of 2014

**Supplemental Budget #04 — P987,714.40**

Resolution No. 270

## Summary

Enacts Supplemental Budget No. 04 for Fiscal Year 2014, appropriating a total of **P987,714.40** for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. This is the fourth supplemental budget for the year, sourced from savings and unexpended appropriations.

## Key Provisions

- **Total Supplemental Appropriation:** P987,714.40
- **Legal Authority:** Enacted pursuant to [[Sec-316-RA7160]] (limitations on use of funds), [[Sec-321-RA7160]] (changes in appropriation), and [[Sec-336-RA7160]] (realignment of appropriations)

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Municipal Budget Office]]
- [[Municipal Treasurer's Office]]

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-316-RA7160]] — General limitations on the use of provincial, city, and municipal funds
- [[Sec-321-RA7160]] — Changes in appropriation
- [[Sec-336-RA7160]] — Realignment of appropriations
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, functions of the Sangguniang Bayan
